title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: How long you in Lakeland for?
Al said the amateur guys were going there for Caesar training
Just for a morning meeting tomorrow then back out on the road
But I live nearby so I’m in and out during the spring
I’m flying down there tomorrow for a day to talk to Perez
Ahh I got ya. I know I owe you a call you just wouldn’t believe the week I had going on when you called In the process of buying a house and selling a house
I’m assuming you’ll be down here to cover some spring training?
Yeah we’ll catch up then. No worries was just calling to talk ball
I’ll get up with ya on one of these drives I have coming up soon
